correctness.rationale: The update polynomial follows from a three-stage second-order tableau. Direct symbolic algebra yields trace=-2bh+O(h²), determinant=a²b²(1-4beta)h⁴ + a²b(8a²beta-a²-b²)h⁵/2+O(h⁶). The symmetric 2x2 trace/determinant criterion settles the strict regimes. The a=b equal-rate factorization proves the full step-range signs and R=I at ah=2. An exact rational h=1 certificate proves strict reentrant contraction at b=11/10. The included executable independently checks all essential equalities with exact SymPy and rational arithmetic. Limits of the universal quantifiers are explicit.

The 2018 general sufficient conditions for even-order methods do not imply these sharp equalities. No inspected broader theorem implies all aspects of the final claim.

value.rationale: At the unresolved equality boundary of a published non-stability coefficient criterion, an HC-index-one rank-one damped oscillator exhibits an exact damping/coupling split, a numerical identity step despite strictly dissipative true evolution, and unexpected strict contraction in a bounded intermediate step window despite infinitesimal and stiff-step amplification. These are motivated sharp stability and time-step-selection phenomena not obtained by a generic textbook scalar test. The rational example provides a reproducible nonnormal stability benchmark and the classification is complete on the natural equal-rate slice.
